page_title: KOL 1-1 HEI | FC Koln v Heidenheim 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Tim Kleindienst will be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
90+1' It will be a substitution. Florian Pick (Heidenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Jan-Niklas Beste walks off.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Philipp Pentke (1. FC Koln) gets a yellow card, off the field.
88' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
88' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from FC Koln as they win a corner.
87' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
86' A clumsy foul by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle. FC Koln will take a free kick.
85' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
83' The game has come to an end for Eren Dinkci. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).

80' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) unleashes a superb shot from distance, forcing a beautiful save out of the keeper. His attempt went towards the right side of the target, but Kevin Muller leapt like a salmon and punched the ball onto the post and away.
77' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but it's cleared.
73' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
72' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
72' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
72' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. It will be a corner kick for FC Koln.
71' Here is a change. Linton Maina is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln).
71' The referee signals a substitution. Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Davie Selke.

68' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) covers his face with his hands after wasting a glorious chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
68' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) on the edge of the box.

68' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Felix Zwayer stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Heidenheim earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

66' It looked like the long-range shot by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
65' Heidenheim keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
61' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' The resulting corner from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' The substitution has been made. Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) has replaced Florian Kainz.

59' A pass lands at the feet of Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to FC Koln.
58' A pass from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
57' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

55' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Jan-Niklas Beste delivers the corner, Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes inside the right post and past the helpless goalkeeper. 1:1.
55' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
54' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln).
53' Dangerous play by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim). Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
51' A mistake by a defender gifts Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
51' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Philipp Pentke (1. FC Koln) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
50' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
46' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Kevin Muller is alert and denies him.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Adrian Beck comes on in place of Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
46' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Norman Theuerkauf.
46' The whistle blows and Felix Zwayer starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Marvin Schwabe punches the ball away.
39' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
35' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

34' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the left side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Marvin Schwabe. Heidenheim get a corner.
33' The Heidenheim players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

29' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) darts into the box to collect a fantastic lofted pass from Florian Kainz and unleashes a powerful shot directed into the bottom left corner. The ball bounces in off the post, increasing the score of today's match. It's now 1:0.
28' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
26' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
25' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
24' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

20' Florian Kainz plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
20' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
20' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the top right corner, but Kevin Muller is alert and makes a decent save. Now FC Koln have a corner.
16' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
13' Heidenheim couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
12' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
11' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

10' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. FC Koln force their opponents to concede a corner.

9' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Muller, who smothers the ball.
6' The free kick from long range, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) brings an opponent down and Felix Zwayer interrupts the game. Heidenheim are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
3' Some neat passing and movement from Heidenheim as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

Heidenheim will kick the game off.
